subject: LeverBank: security sprint priorities & evidence plan
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <sshah@leverbank.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@leverbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: LeverBank: security sprint priorities & evidence plan

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the demo & walkthrough today. Quick recap from Redwood and proposed next steps so we can keep the sprint tight and make the acceptance window predictable. High-level items we heard as the priority from your side:

- SOC 2 scope and timeline: you want evidence that hosting, change control, and incident response controls cover the user data flows for card tokenization (important for compliance sign-off).
- Audit logs & retention: confirmation of audit log granularity (who/what/when), retention policy (accessible retention for 6+ months), and exportability to your SIEM.
- DPA clauses & retention language: a few DPA redlines (data deletion, subprocessor notice window, and retention exceptions) that need legal review.
- Pen test coordination: a short window needed for our infra team to coordinate — you indicated an internal preferred week of Nov 29–Dec 3.

What we propose (owners and target dates):
1) Evidence intake folder + mapping template — Redwood to share template for artifacts (SOC 2 reports, control narratives, audit log examples) by EOD 2027-11-07. Owner: Irene.
2) Quick control mapping doc (how Redwood controls map to your DDQ) — Redwood to deliver draft by 2027-11-10. Owner: Aditya.
3) DPA redlines — please share the redline PDF; Redwood legal will respond within 5 business days from receipt. Owner: Priya (to send) / Redwood legal (to respond).
4) Pen test window confirmation — target week Nov 29–Dec 3; Redwood will provide scope and pre-test checklist by 2027-11-12. Owner: Evelyn.

Attachments I just dropped in the shared folder (link below): a one-page sprint outline and the evidence intake spreadsheet we discussed. Please upload any artifacts to that folder and flag anything that is restricted.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-levbank-evidence

Immediate asks for you:
- Confirm the preferred pen-test week (Nov 29–Dec 3) or give 2 alternates.
- Share the DPA redline (if ready) or indicate timeline for legal to send.
- If you can, upload any SOC 2 report excerpts or control narratives that you already have — even partials help speed mapping.

I’m looping Aditya and Evelyn on the logistics and artifact intake. We’ll keep this concise and will surface only the minimal set of documents needed for acceptance.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Irene Choi
Solutions Lead, Compliance & Security
Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-soc2-sprint-outline.pdf; leverbank-evidence-intake-template.xlsx

From: Samir Shah <sshah@leverbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@leverbank.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 17:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LeverBank: security sprint priorities & evidence plan

Irene —

Appreciate the clear recap — this matches our notes. Quick answers:

- Pen test window: Nov 29–Dec 3 works for our security ops team; please include a short list of required IP ranges and a pre-test questionnaire.
- DPA redline: legal is finishing up; I’ll try to get the redline to you by Tue 11/9. Expect it as a PDF.
- SOC 2 material: we can surface the last SOC 2 Type II report PDF and control narratives for the tokenization flow. I’ll ask our compliance lead to upload to the Drive folder (or I can send via SFTP if you prefer).

Two quick questions for Redwood:
1) For audit logs — can you confirm whether you retain read/write metadata (not just service logs) for 6 months and whether exports can be pulled as JSON?
2) For subprocessor list — do you maintain a current list of subprocessors and a 30-day notice window for changes?

Thanks — Samir

On Sun, Nov 7, 2027 at 3:02 PM Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2027 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: LeverBank: security sprint priorities & evidence plan — artifact handoff

Team — forwarding Samir’s note. Action items for Redwood before Tue 11/9:

- Aditya: prepare the control mapping draft (SOC 2 controls -> LeverBank DDQ) and include a short explanation of where prefix/KV caching and audit logging live in our infra. Target: 2027-11-10.
- Marcus: gather sample audit log extracts (anonymized) showing user identifiers obfuscated, include format (JSON) and export steps. Upload to Drive folder and mark as "redacted sample". Target: 2027-11-09 EOD.
- Evelyn: start pen-test pre-checklist (IP ranges, account creation for testing, blast radius controls) and the scheduling ICS file. Add pen-test scope doc to folder. Target: 2027-11-12.

Checklist for the folder (leverbank-evidence-intake):
- SOC 2 Type II (PDF) or SOC 2 summary + control narratives
- Audit log export samples (JSON) and retention policy excerpt
- Subprocessor list and notification process text
- DPA redline (from their legal) — once we receive, we’ll route to Redwood legal and aim to respond in 5 business days

Permissions note: create a "LeverBank-reviewers" group with view+comment access only. If they need to upload restricted material, let them use the SFTP endpoint (details in sprint outline).

I’m copying Samir on the internal action list so they see the owners and timelines. If anything slips, call me directly — I’ll own escalation.

—
Irene

(Onward: attachment stubs uploaded: leverbank-evidence-intake-template.xlsx; pen-test-window-availability.ics)

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@leverbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Samir Shah <sshah@leverbank.com>

Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LeverBank: security sprint priorities & evidence plan

Thanks Irene — sound plan. We’ll do the following from our side:

- I uploaded the latest SOC 2 Type II (redacted) and the tokenization control narrative to the Drive folder. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-levbank-evidence (files prefixed LB_).
- DPA redline is attached and sent to your legal: https://www.docusign.com/xyz/leverbank-dpa. Please have legal review and advise on the three clauses we flagged (deletion, subprocessors, and exception retention).
- Confirming pen-test week Nov 29–Dec 3. Security ops will accept the pre-test questionnaire and approve the scope after you share it.

We prefer the SFTP for anything sensitive — I’ll ask my compliance lead to use SFTP for the full reports. Samir will coordinate the upload.

Let us know if Redwood needs a PO or formal security addendum before the pen test; we can run that in parallel.

Best,
Priya Rao
CTO (Acting), LeverBank
priya.rao@leverbank.com
